captions.title: The two funds
captions.line: A share of every recorded deal goes into each, whoever closed it and whether or not anybody earned commission.

captions.title: What the Foundation holds
captions.line: Held now, all time. A balance is the sum of its history, never a stored number.

captions.title: Record a payment out
captions.line: This is the only way money leaves it. The prize pool is different: that leaves through an award.

captions.title: How much
captions.line: It will not take more than the fund holds. A negative balance would be the fund claiming it gave away money it never had.

captions.title: What it paid for
captions.line: Write what a reader needs a year from now. Not "project".

captions.title: The receipt
captions.line: At least one. Money leaving needs evidence, the same rule a recorded sale follows.

captions.title: Record it
captions.line: The balance drops by exactly that amount.

captions.title: And the history says why
captions.line: The payment sits at the top, carrying what it paid for and who recorded it. Nothing here is ever edited.
